facts.fact: ARPTC's president says a ministerial order of 17 August 2024 provisionally entrusted the regulator with electronic certification and that it is called to act as the national certification issuing authority; no operating service is described.
facts.system: Autorite Nationale d'emission de Certification Electronique (ARPTC)

facts.fact: The ARPTC president marks two years of application of Ordonnance-Loi No 23/010 of 13 March 2023 on the Digital Code, which the speech says governs personal data protection.
The ARPTC president says the ministerial order of 17 August 2024 provisionally entrusted the regulator with personal data protection and that it will pursue awareness, controls and sanctions.

COD.note: The duty to host personal data nationally is stated for personal data in general, not government data.

facts.fact: The ARPTC president says the Digital Code (Ordonnance-Loi No 23/010 of 13 March 2023), in application for two years, sets a specific legal regime for digital services including trust services.
The ARPTC president cites a ministerial order of 17 August 2024 harmonising how the Digital Code's regimes are implemented and entrusting some activities provisionally to ARPTC.

COD.note: A think tank's conference is named but no research or publication is stated.
